meta.name: crossing-the-chasm
meta.description: Navigate the technology adoption lifecycle from early adopters to mainstream market. Use when the user mentions "crossing the chasm", "beachhead segment", "whole product", "early adopters vs mainstream", "tech go-to-market", "bowling pin strategy", "technology adoption lifecycle", "pragmatist buyers", "growth stalled after early adopters", or "our go-to-market plan". Also trigger when planning go-to-market for a technical product. Covers the D-Day analogy, bowling-pin strategy, the tornado, and positioning against incumbents. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome. For new market creation, see blue-ocean-strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定技术产品跨越早期市场进入主流市场的策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的技术产品在早期用户后增长停滞，需要进入主流市场。
copy.tagline_en: Navigate the technology adoption lifecycle from early adopters to mainstream market.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your tech product growth stalls after early adopters and you need to reach mainstream market.

howto.what: 当用户讨论技术产品从早期用户转向主流市场时，Claude 会提供跨越鸿沟的策略，包括选择滩头阵地、完善整体产品、定位和上市计划。
howto.when: 当用户提到“跨越鸿沟”、“滩头阵地”、“整体产品”、“早期采用者 vs 主流”、“技术上市”、“保龄球瓶策略”、“技术采用生命周期”、“实用主义买家”、“早期采用者后增长停滞”或“我们的上市计划”等关键词，或讨论技术产品上市时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析我们产品的滩头阵地选择。
